def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    color = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    r0, c0 = min(r for r, c in points), min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    sh, sw = max(r for r, c in shape)+1, max(c for r, c in shape)+1
    for top in range(h-sh+1):
        for left in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(grid[top+dr][left+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[top+dr][left+dc] = color
    return out
